note: This file is a static configuration dictionary (no callable functions, classes, or methods). It defines model settings for a ResNet-101 ImageClassifier in the MMSelfSup/MMDetection framework.
config_model_type: configure an ImageClassifier model using ResNet-101 backbone with GlobalAveragePooling neck and LinearClsHead
config_backbone_resnet101: configure a ResNet backbone with depth 101, 4 stages, pytorch style, and output index 3
config_neck_global_avg_pool: configure a GlobalAveragePooling neck layer for the image classifier model
config_head_linear_cls: configure a LinearClsHead with 1000 classes, 2048 input channels, and CrossEntropyLoss
config_loss_cross_entropy: configure a CrossEntropyLoss with loss weight 1.0 for the classification head
